item.title: ‘True to the historic commitment’: France recognises Palestinian state at UN
item.description: France formally recognised the state of Palestine at the UN General Assembly, joined by several other nations, as world leaders pushed for a two-state solution. Despite opposition from Israel and criticism from the US, the move reflects a growing global consensus, offering a glimmer of hope amid ongoing conflict and devastation in Gaza.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Denmark's Copenhagen airport shut: 2-3 unidentified drones sighted in airspace; several flights diverted
item.description: Operations at Copenhagen airport halted. This happened because of drone sightings. Authorities closed the airspace. Around fifteen flights were rerouted. Police reported seeing three or four large drones. These drones were flying near the airport. Investigations are underway. Officials have not yet determined when the airport will reopen. The situation remains unresolved at this time.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'It's not good': Donald Trump links pain reliver Tylenol's use in pregnancy to autism; Leucovorin approved as treatment
item.description: President Trump has sparked controversy by suggesting pregnant individuals limit Tylenol use due to an unsubstantiated link to autism and advocating for delayed infant vaccination schedules, particularly for Hepatitis B. Medical experts have strongly refuted Trump's claims, emphasizing the safety of acetaminophen during pregnancy and the critical importance of newborn Hepatitis B vaccination.

item.title: From US to Russia: Tara Reade granted citizenship by Vladimir Putin; accused Joe Biden of sexual assault in 1990s
item.description: Vladimir Putin granted Russian citizenship to Tara Reade, who accused Joe Biden of sexual assault in the 1990s. Reade, who had previously expressed fear for her safety in the US, announced her intention to seek Russian citizenship in 2023. She later stated plans to return to the US to file a complaint against Biden before he withdrew from his re-election bid.

item.title: US shooting: Teenager critical after being shot in head in Queens; probe under way
item.description: A 13-year-old boy is in critical condition after being shot in the head outside a Dunkin' in Cambria Heights, Queens. The incident occurred in the parking lot of a mall on Linden Boulevard and Springfield, prompting a large police response. Residents expressed concerns about safety, especially for students from nearby Andrew Jackson High School who frequent the area.

item.title: 12 years behind bars: Egypt pardons prominent activist Alaa Abd el-Fattah; family, supporters celebrate release
item.description: Egyptian authorities have announced a presidential pardon for prominent activist Alaa Abd el-Fattah, imprisoned for nearly 12 years. Abd el-Fattah, a symbol of the Arab Spring uprising, was serving a five-year sentence for spreading false news. His release, expected soon, follows international pressure and tireless campaigning by his family, who are hopeful for his swift reunion.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Tucker Carlson remarks at Charlie Kirk memorial: Why far-right commentator was accused of anti-Semitism
item.description: Tucker Carlson's speech at a Charlie Kirk memorial has sparked antisemitism accusations due to his comparison of Kirk's death to Jesus' crucifixion, employing language echoing antisemitic tropes. Critics point to his insinuations of cultural or political responsibility, despite evidence indicating otherwise, as reinforcing harmful stereotypes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE suspends tourist and work visa applications for nine countries: Full breakdown of the 2026 visa ban
item.description: The UAE has halted the issuance of tourist and work visas for citizens of nine countries, including Bangladesh, Uganda, and Afghanistan, under a 2026 immigration directive. Though not officially confirmed, the ban is linked to security, health, and diplomatic concerns. Existing UAE visa holders remain unaffected, while new applications from the listed nations are currently not being accepted.

item.title: In a first, China’s Fujian carrier launches jets with catapult system – watch
item.description: China's navy has successfully tested electromagnetic catapult launches and arrested landings on its new aircraft carrier, the Fujian, marking a significant milestone. The J-15T, J-35, and KongJing-600 aircraft completed the training, indicating the carrier's readiness for induction. This advancement allows China to potentially operate three carrier groups, raising concerns amid regional territorial disputes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai: Emirates cancels multiple flights as super typhoon Ragasa nears Southern China
item.description: Dubai-based Emirates has cancelled 11 flights to Hong Kong and Shenzhen from September 23 to 25 due to Super Typhoon Ragasa. Shuttle services to Bangkok are also suspended. Passengers transiting through Dubai to affected cities won’t be accepted for travel. Authorities in Hong Kong are closing the airport for 36 hours as the region braces for severe weather.
